BUSINESS MEMBERSHIP
Three steps to member pricing.

Just need a quote? Send a quick inquiry without completing membership verification.

01
Tell us about your business

Provide your work email, legal business name and registered business address.

02
Complete business verification

Provide your EIN. Supporting business documents may be requested during review.

03
Access member pricing

Once approved, access the published quantity discounts and request custom pricing for larger orders.

BUSINESS PAYMENT OPTIONS
Flexible payment options for business orders.

Your order confirmation or invoice will identify the available payment methods. Do not enter banking information on this page.

01
Invoice via QuickBooks

Receive an itemized invoice for your approved order and keep a copy for your records.

02
Card payment via Stripe

Use a secure hosted payment link for eligible corporate card transactions.

03
ACH transfer

Bank-to-bank payment instructions are provided on the approved invoice.

04
Wire transfer

Available for approved bulk orders using verified payment instructions.

05
Corporate card

Major cards may be accepted depending on order value, account verification and applicable processing fees.

06
Purchase order & pro forma invoice

Reference your purchase order on a pro forma invoice. Payment is required before order release unless otherwise stated.

All payment methods are subject to account verification, product eligibility, order value and final invoice instructions. Always verify bank instructions with an authorized GARVEE representative before sending payment.
